fusions.name: Interrupting Cast
fusions.desc: A throw that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Bolt
fusions.desc: Throws a drilled point of force that deals 5 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 8% per affliction the target carries, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Measured Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana at once. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Word Ready
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
